text:
maya: Heads-up — I'm OOO tomorrow and the docs preview queue is ~6 PRs with failing linkcheck and a couple small snippet merges. Can someone cover the docs reviewer slot for the day? cc @platform-oncall

sam: I can cover mornings til 1pm PT. Which PRs need +1? Linkcheck failures are mostly relative links.

maya: Thanks! The urgent ones: PR #314 - SDK snippet update (small); PR #318 - migration guide link fixes (linkcheck); PR #321 - CLI example missing code fence. CI preview shows error in preview-builder: `Error: could not render markdown for /docs/migration/...`

leo: I can take PR#318 and #321. For the preview error, try running `yarn docs:build --filter migration` locally; also the preview bot sometimes hides stack trace — see logs at https://ci.internal/324/preview-logs.

ashley-docs: I'll do the SDK snippet PR after lunch. Quick note: for PR#314 make sure the snippet uses the new SDK method `client.create_response` not `client.generate`.

maya: Tagging workflows: please add `docs-reviewer:temp` label so automation routes to the right reviewer and prevents auto-merge until linkcheck passes.

dev-bot: label `docs-reviewer:temp` added by maya.

sam: Re: auto-merge, we should hold off until preview checks are green. If linkcheck still failing, you can add the `linkcheck-exempt` flag in frontmatter with a note, but only for known external redirects.

leo: Ran `yarn docs:build --filter migration` locally — error was an absolute path in a relative link. Pushed fix in #318. Preview re-triggered.

dev-bot: preview build for PR#318 started (build 3248594382).

ashley-docs: FYI, for snippet PR I'll include a unit test in examples/ for the snippet so it doesn't regress. Will ping when ready for review.

sam: Great. For merge timing, let's aim for the 2pm PT merge window — gives enough time to catch final preview issues. If anything blocks, DM me.

maya: Massive thanks team :heart: — leaving the checklist in the PRs. I'll check in on Slack tomorrow AM but otherwise I trust you.
